title: Ambiguous-case pilot selection rule
population: Genuinely Ambiguous / Unclassified Large Load tier
selection_principle: Select a small methodological pilot that maximizes closure diversity and reproducibility rather than raw site count.
eligibility: initial_registry_classification == Genuinely Ambiguous / Unclassified Large Load
stable queue/load record available for the candidate
candidate is large enough to remain inside the registry's declared research threshold or source universe
coverage_dimensions: deliberate inconclusive outcome and stopping rule
selection_note: The three-case pilot is intentionally not presented as a representative sample of the 141-facility tier. It is a methodological test set designed to demonstrate both successful adjudication and honest non-closure.
